## Design Decisions Made Under Latitude

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| Breakpoint | Keep 900px | The viewer's `.doc`/rail collapse and content-visibility estimates already live there; the site's 960px touches unrelated rules for no functional gain (documented in CSS comment) |
| Markup approach | Single markup restyled by media query | One `.toc-link` set keeps 9-link `SECTION_IDS` parity trivially verifiable; dual markup risks copy drift and needs JS changes to drive both sets (documented in CSS + HTML comments) |
| Overflow guard | `hidden`, not `clip` | The viewer's sticky elements (site-nav, mobile TOC bar) are body children; body/html overflow propagates to the viewport so sticky keeps working — the site itself runs `body{overflow-x:hidden}` + sticky nav (documented in CSS comment) |
| Spy offset | Constant → per-call function | `--toc-scroll-height` is responsive; without it the spy would highlight the previous section after mobile anchor jumps (~one `getComputedStyle` per rAF frame — negligible) |
| Hero h1 small-phone override | Added 560px block | Mirrors the site's own learn-hero mobile override |
